# Field notes

Two topics in one file, and one unit built from each. The two sections below are
disjoint regions of this single file: neither unit is the file, and the file is
not either unit.

## 1. Taking a reading

Read the gauge at the same hour every day, and write the hour down beside the
number.

### What to record

The date, the hour, and the depth in millimetres.

```yaml
### A hash at the start of a line inside a fence is not a heading, and these
### two are deep enough to land inside the region above rather than end it.
readings_per_day: 1
```

## 2. Writing it down

Copy the reading into the book on the same day. A reading nobody wrote down is
a reading nobody has.

```xml
<notes>
  <entry day="1">2 mm</entry>
</notes>
```
